meta.name: push-to-forked-pr
meta.description: Push the current working tree directly to a GitHub PR whose head lives on a **fork**, without creating a new branch and without pushing to `origin` (which is usually the upstream). Invoke when the user says things like "push straight to PR

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 直接推送本地改动到已有的拉取请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要往已有的拉取请求补提交,又不想多建分支。
copy.tagline_en: Push local changes directly to an existing pull request without creating a new branch.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to push straight to an existing PR from a fork without creating extra branches.

howto.what: 你可以让 Claude 把当前改动直接推进一个来自 fork 的 PR。它会先检查 PR 是否开放、权限是否足够，跑完测试后再推送到 fork 分支，绝不新建分支，也绝不推给上游。
howto.when: 当你说“直接推到 PR #N”、“更新这个 fork 的 PR”等类似请求，或强调不新建分支、不推给上游仓库时，Claude 会接管这个推送操作。

say.text: 把当前改动直接推到 PR #42，不要新建分支。
更新那个来自 fork 的 PR，别推到 origin。
say.note: 它会把本地 HEAD 推到 PR 对应的 fork 分支。

say.text: 将这些提交推到 #7 的 fork 分支上。

howto.what_en: Claude can push local changes straight to a GitHub PR whose branch is on a fork. It verifies the PR is open and you have permission, runs tests, then pushes to the fork branch—no new branch, no pushing to origin.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to push directly to a PR, update a forked PR, or avoid creating a branch or pushing to origin. Also used instead of plain git push origin when the PR head repo differs from local origin.

say_en.text: Push these changes directly to PR #42, no new branch.
say_en.note: Claude will push to the PR's fork branch after checks.

say_en.text: Update the forked PR without pushing to origin.
say_en.note: It pushes your local HEAD to the fork branch.

say_en.text: Push these commits to the fork branch of #7.
